stances.claim: The Marcos petition's allegation that VCMs were uniformly defective is self-defeating because if true, ALL 2016 election winners -- including Duterte himself -- would be unseated; this preposterous breadth undermines the credibility of the broader fraud claim.
stances.rhetorical_move: reductio-ad-absurdum (extending the allegation reveals its absurd consequence)

stances.claim: The hash-code-into-Transparency-Server allegation has been repeatedly debunked by Comelec, PPCRV, and independent technology experts as an unfortunate incident not affecting results integrity -- making it a non-serious basis for protest.

Comelec should not bear the P2.078B Smartmatic VCM lease cost -- Marcos as the protestant should pay; further, the VCMs need not be used in the recount at all because dust/water exposure in warehouses makes feeding ballots into them impractical, and SD card images decrypted in Comelec laptops (in the presence of parties and lawyers) provide a faster, cleaner data source.
stances.rhetorical_move: cost-allocation + technical-alternative argument (the protestant pays + use SD cards not VCMs)

stances.claim: In the normal course, the Marcos protest will take at least 2 years and the Robredo counterprotest at least 1 more year -- meaning the case will not see light for several years, removing any 'immediate prospect' of Marcos replacing Robredo via this route.
stances.rhetorical_move: timeline-projection grounded in PET procedural requirements

notable_anecdotes: Duterte's Phnom Penh disclosure of his health conditions (Buerger's disease, daily migraine, terrible back pains) and possible non-completion of term -- used as the column's opening hook explaining why public attention shifted to the VP succession question.
The specific Smartmatic exposure figure 'P2,078,304,225.76' -- preserved to the centavo to physicalize the absurdity of Comelec bearing the cost rather than Marcos.
CJ's pithy verdict 'Why the Comelec would have to pay this staggering amount is beyond me. I think Marcos should pay it' -- the most personally direct intervention in the column.

The two election-law titans matched in this case: 'George Garcia for Marcos and Romulo Macalintal for Robredo' -- CJ's parting note treating the litigation as also a generational lawyer-vs-lawyer contest.

one_paragraph_summary: Panganiban addresses public anxiety triggered by Duterte's December 14, 2016 Phnom Penh speech disclosing his Buerger's disease, daily migraine, and back pains and the possibility he may not finish his six-year term -- which has refocused attention on Bongbong Marcos's PET election protest against VP Leni Robredo. He examines the 1,000-page petition backed by over 20,000 affidavits: the broad VCM-defect allegation is self-defeating because if true, all 2016 winners including Duterte would be unseated; the hash-code-into-Transparency-Server claim has been repeatedly debunked by Comelec, PPCRV, and technology experts. What caught the PET's attention is the narrower 'traditional modes of cheating' allegation in 39,221 clustered precincts (97,366 VCMs) in 25 provinces and 5 cities. The PET's December 6, 2016 resolution flagged a potential P2,078,304,225.76 Smartmatic VCM lease cost -- which CJ argues Marcos (not Comelec) should pay, and notes the VCMs need not be used because warehouse dust/water exposure makes them impractical; SD card images decrypted in Comelec laptops in the presence of parties and lawyers offer a cleaner faster data source. Even with this efficiency, revision logistics (document gathering by AFP/PNP, revision committees compensated from Marcos deposits, 4.3 average established precincts per clustered precinct) mean the Marcos protest will take at least 2 years and Robredo's 8,042-clustered-precinct counterprotest in 13 provinces at least 1 more year. The 'inevitable conclusion is that, in the normal course, it will take a few more years of hard work before we see light in the case,' which is being litigated by 'two of the brightest election lawyers' -- George Garcia for Marcos and Romulo Macalintal for Robredo.
